_about: Closed vocabulary for the `tag` in a LESSONS.md heading. One tag = one rule family across projects. `owner` is the default skill that carries the rule; a lesson may name another owner when the mechanism is theirs. Add a tag here BEFORE using it — verify-lessons.mjs rejects unknown tags, which is the point: an unknown tag is a lesson nobody can count.
